name: CanaryGuard
description: Deterministic heuristic detector for prompt injection, concealed Unicode, and wallet drain commands.

CANARYGUARD_URL.label: Service URL
CANARYGUARD_URL.help: Optional remote CanaryGuard service URL. Defaults to offline local engine when unset.

CANARYGUARD_PAYMENT_HEADER.label: Payment Header
CANARYGUARD_PAYMENT_HEADER.help: Optional x402 payment authorization signature for remote verification.

CANARYGUARD_STRICT_MODE.label: Strict Mode
CANARYGUARD_STRICT_MODE.help: When true (default), completely blanks blocked messages; when false, selectively scrubs instruction lines.
